profile_text.body:
Inceptive is a for-profit startup founded in 2021 and headquartered in Palo Alto, California. Its website describes the company as building foundation models of life, models that extrapolate from data to design medicines for what it calls humanity's most challenging diseases. The company frames its work around learning the mechanisms of life and designing novel therapies, and says it is hiring scientists and engineers across AI and bio.

Inceptive describes partnerships as strategic alliances, working with partners over time to tune models, use data, and transfer knowledge, and invites discussion of how its team and technology can support an AI investment and pipeline. It describes its team as antedisciplinary, made up of scientists, AI researchers, and engineers who work together where wet and dry meet.

No lawsuits involving the company are recorded, and no MCP servers or specific products are listed for it. Its recorded litigation exposure sits in California.
